The '''Illodians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Illodia]],<ref name="AGSWU3">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]]<ref name="CSWE-lllodia" /> of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' [[Illodia sector/Legends|Illodia sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> They had long lifespans.<ref name="CSWE-lllodia" /> The Illodians [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]]<ref name="AGSWU3" /> twenty scattered worlds that made up their [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="CSWE-lllodia sector">{{CSWECite|II|83|Illodia sector}}</ref> They were ruled by an [[oligarchy]] of five clans<ref name="CSWE-lllodia" /> that proved longer-lived than many [[Blood/Legends|blood]] [[Monarchy/Legends|dynasties]].<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> The species spoke a [[Language/Legends|language]] known as [[Illodian Sibilant]].<ref name="SWE" />
